(c) The Prime Minister directs, controls and co-ordinates the activities of all the ministers.

question_kannada: Which of the following statements regarding Vice President of India is INCORRECT?
option_1_english: Only elected members of the Parliament vote in his/her election
option_2_english: He is ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha
option_3_english: The President of India administers oath of office to him/her

option_1_kannada: Only elected members of the Parliament vote in his/her election

option_3_kannada: The President of India administers oath of office to him/her
option_4_kannada: The members of state legislative assemblies do not participate in his/her election
explanation_english:
Correct Answer: (1) Only elected members of the Parliament vote in his/her election

Explanation: The Vice-President is elected by an electoral college of all members — elected and nominated — of both Houses of Parliament (Article 66). So 'only elected members' is incorrect.

Options 2, 3 and 4 are incorrect (they are true): the VP is ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, takes oath before the President, and State MLAs have no role in the election.

question_kannada:

(b) Only two Articles 323A and 323B are related to tribunals
(c) Article 323B deals with Administrative tribunals
(d) The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 and the Administrative Tribunal Act of 1985 is related to Articles 323A and 323B
explanation_english:
Correct Answer: (4) (b), (c) and (d) are correct

Explanation: The original Constitution had no provisions on tribunals — Part XIV-A (Articles 323A and 323B) was added by the 42nd Amendment, 1976, so (a) is false and (b) and (d) are true (the Administrative Tribunals Act, 1985 was enacted under Article 323A). Strictly, Article 323A deals with administrative tribunals and 323B with tribunals for other matters, so (c) is imprecise. Option 4 is the only code that excludes the clearly false statement (a).

Options 1, 2 and 3 are incorrect because they include (a). Note: statement (c) is inaccurate as printed — verify against the official key.

question_kannada:
Read the statements with regard to Troposphere.

(d) Atmospheric pressure decreases with height.

explanation_english:
Correct Answer: (4) (a), (c) and (d)

Explanation: In the troposphere temperature falls with height (about 6.5 °C per km), and both the density of gases and atmospheric pressure decrease with height. Options 1, 2 and 3 are incorrect because they include (b).

ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ: (4) (a), (c) and (d)

question_kannada:
With reference to the Round Table conferences and the issue of electorates, consider the following statements.
(a) At the Second Round Table Conference in 1931, B.R. Ambedkar demanded separate electorates for the depressed classes.
(b) Mahatma Gandhi completely supported Ambedkar's demand to empower the lower castes.
(c) Gandhiji argued that separate electorate would permanently segregate the depressed classes from mainstream society.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation_english:
Correct Answer: (2) (a) and (c) only

Explanation: At the Second RTC (1931) Ambedkar demanded separate electorates for the depressed classes (a). Gandhiji opposed it, arguing it would divide Hindu society and permanently segregate the depressed classes (c); this led to his fast and the Poona Pact (1932). So (b) is wrong.

Options 1, 3 and 4 are incorrect.

question_kannada:
Consider the following statements with reference to Kalyana Chalukyas:
(a) Tailapa II defeated the Paramara King Munja
(b) Vikramaditya IV started the Chalukya Vikrama Era in 1076.
(c) Somesvara I shifted the capital to Kalyana permanently.
(d) Tailapa II was overthrown by the Kalachuri King Bijjala.
How many of the above statement/statements is/are correct?
explanation_english:
Correct Answer: (2) Two only

Explanation: (a) is correct — Tailapa II defeated and killed Paramara Munja (c. 995). (c) is correct — Someshvara I made Kalyana the capital. (b) is wrong — the Chalukya Vikrama Era (1076) was started by Vikramaditya VI. (d) is wrong — Bijjala overthrew Tailapa III, not Tailapa II. So two statements are correct.

Options 1, 3 and 4 are incorrect.
explanation_kannada:
ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ: (2) Two only

ವಿವರಣೆ: (a) ಸರಿ – ಇಮ್ಮಡಿ ತೈಲಪ ಪರಮಾರ ಮುಂಜನನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಿದ; (c) ಸರಿ – ಒಂದನೇ ಸೋಮೇಶ್ವರ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣವನ್ನು ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ಮಾಡಿದ. (b) ತಪ್ಪು – ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯ ವಿಕ್ರಮ ಶಕ ಆರನೇ ವಿಕ್ರಮಾದಿತ್ಯನದು; (d) ತಪ್ಪು – ಬಿಜ್ಜಳ ಮೂರನೇ ತೈಲಪನನ್ನು ಉರುಳಿಸಿದ.

ಆಯ್ಕೆ 1, 3 ಮತ್ತು 4 ತಪ್ಪಾಗಿವೆ.

question_english:
Identify the correct statement/statements with regard to "EK Ped Maa Ke Naam" campaign.
(a) This campaign was inaguarated on June 5, 2026 on the occasion of World Environment Day.
(b) This campaign was inaugurated by planting of a peepal tree by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi at Buddha Jayanti Park, New Delhi on June 5, 2024.
(c) This campaign aligns with the nation's quest for sustainable development.
question_kannada:
Identify the correct statement/statements with regard to "EK Ped Maa Ke Naam" campaign.
(a) This campaign was inaguarated on June 5, 2026 on the occasion of World Environment Day.
(b) This campaign was inaugurated by planting of a peepal tree by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi at Buddha Jayanti Park, New Delhi on June 5, 2024.
(c) This campaign aligns with the nation's quest for sustainable development.
explanation_english:
Correct Answer: (3) (b) and (c)

Explanation: 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' was launched on World Environment Day, 5 June 2024, when the Prime Minister planted a peepal sapling at Buddha Jayanti Park, New Delhi (b), and it supports sustainable development (c). It was not inaugurated in 2026, so (a) is wrong.

Options 1, 2 and 4 are incorrect.
explanation_kannada:
ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ: (3) (b) and (c)

ವಿವರಣೆ: 'ಏಕ್ ಪೇಡ್ ಮಾ ಕೆ ನಾಮ್' ಅಭಿಯಾನ 5 ಜೂನ್ 2024 ರಂದು ಬುದ್ಧ ಜಯಂತಿ ಉದ್ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅರಳಿ ಸಸಿ ನೆಟ್ಟು ಆರಂಭ (b); ಸುಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ಪೂರಕ (c). 2026 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ – (a) ತಪ್ಪು.

ಆಯ್ಕೆ 1, 2 ಮತ್ತು 4 ತಪ್ಪಾಗಿವೆ.

question_english:
Consider the following statements with regard to 'Ashadeep' programme of Government of Karnataka.
(a) This programme is aimed at providing employment opportunities to OBC candidates in private sector
(b) Under this programme, employers are reimbursed ESI and EPF contribution up to ₹3000 per candidate per month for a period of 2 years.
(c) For newly recruited candidates, a wage reimbursement of Rs. 10,000 per month per candidate is provided for two years.
Which of the above statement/s is/are correct?
question_kannada:
Consider the following statements with regard to 'Ashadeep' programme of Government of Karnataka.
(a) This programme is aimed at providing employment opportunities to OBC candidates in private sector
(b) Under this programme, employers are reimbursed ESI and EPF contribution up to ₹3000 per candidate per month for a period of 2 years.
(c) For newly recruited candidates, a wage reimbursement of Rs. 10,000 per month per candidate is provided for two years.
Which of the above statement/s is/are correct?
explanation_english:
Correct Answer: (2) Only (b)

Explanation: Karnataka's Ashadeep scheme (Social Welfare Department) encourages private employers to hire SC/ST candidates — not OBC — by reimbursing the employer's ESI/EPF contribution for two years (b). So (a) is wrong, and (c) does not describe the scheme as printed.

Options 1, 3 and 4 are incorrect because they include (a). Note: verify against the official key.
explanation_kannada:
ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ: (2) Only (b)

ವಿವರಣೆ: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ 'ಆಶಾದೀಪ' ಯೋಜನೆ ಖಾಸಗಿ ವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ SC/ST ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳ (OBC ಅಲ್ಲ) ಉದ್ಯೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜನ; ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಾತರಿಗೆ ESI/EPF ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ (b). (a) ತಪ್ಪು.

ಆಯ್ಕೆ 1, 3 ಮತ್ತು 4 ತಪ್ಪಾಗಿವೆ. ಸೂಚನೆ: ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಕೀ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
